title: Neon Pulse — Episode 16: The Trap Springs
description: Kael confronts Commander Vance inside the syndicate data hub only to realize it was all a carefully prepared trap.
character_reference: a tall, lean man with messy dark hair, wearing a worn charcoal-grey tactical jacket with glowing amber circuitry patterns running down his sleeves

scenes.narration: Heavy blast doors slam shut from the ceiling, sealing every exit of the circular chamber. Commander Vance stands calmly behind an impenetrable glass barrier, watching the sudden imprisonment.
scenes.visual: Low angle shot of heavy steel blast doors crashing downward into a metallic floor inside a high tech control room, dramatic amber warning lights flashing along the reinforced walls

scenes.narration: The amber circuitry patterns along my sleeves flare with intense light. I thrust my palm forward, unleashing a shockwave of kinetic energy directly at the reinforced glass.
scenes.visual: Close up on a hand thrusting forward with bright amber glowing energy bursting outward from the palm, striking a thick transparent barrier with blinding impact sparks

scenes.narration: The barrier barely shatters, absorbing the blast entirely. Vance chuckles coldly from the console, tapping a sequence that activates the dampening fields.
scenes.visual: Medium shot of an older military commander smirking behind a glowing digital control console inside a sleek underground bunker, cold blue ambient illumination casting sharp shadows

scenes.narration: A sharp, high-pitched hum echoes through the chamber as invisible suppression rings lock onto my arms. My knees buckle under the sudden crushing weight of the energy drain.
scenes.visual: Medium close up of a man kneeling in defeat on a metallic grate floor, hands raised defensively as translucent energy rings bind tightly around his forearms

scenes.narration: You built this power in me, Vance. But you clearly underestimated what it takes to break it. I grit my teeth and fight the suppression field.
scenes.visual: Close up of a determined face with gritted teeth and strained expression, sweat glistening on skin illuminated by pulsing amber light reflecting from the side

scenes.narration: Before the containment field can fully neutralize my pulse, I channel every remaining ounce of energy inward. The console sparks violently as the system overloads.
scenes.visual: Wide shot of a massive server rack exploding with a cascade of fiery sparks and short-circuiting cables inside a dark industrial server hall

scenes.narration: The entire facility shudders from the backlash, plunging the room into emergency darkness. When the backup lights flicker on, Vance is already gone.
scenes.visual: Wide shot of a smoky, ruined control chamber lit only by dim red emergency beacons, an empty platform visible behind shattered glass

scenes.narration: The trap failed to hold, but the war has only just begun. Follow along for more of the story every single week.
scenes.visual: Medium shot of a solitary figure standing heroically amidst curling smoke and glowing debris, looking ahead with unyielding resolve into the shadows
